segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, thanks for making time. I wanted to walk through the updated quote for 48 seats and make sure the March 18 go-live still works on your side.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, that timing still works. We have 42 users confirmed now, and then six more in customer success probably by April. So 48 is the right number.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. The annual subscription comes to $38,400, and implementation is a one-time $4,500. That includes the admin training, data import, and two working sessions with your ops lead.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And payment terms are net 30, right? Our finance team asked because they cut checks on Thursdays.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, net 30 from invoice date. If we get signature by Friday, billing can issue the invoice on Monday, February 12, so it would be due March 13.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That should be fine. On the contract, I saw the renewal is one year after the start date. Is the start date March 18 or the signature date?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: March 18. The agreement can be signed earlier, but the service term starts on the go-live date, so renewal would be March 18 next year.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. Last thing, can you confirm we can add seats mid-year at the same per-seat rate?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes. Additional seats are prorated through the end of the current term at $800 per seat annually. I’ll make sure that language is in the order form.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. Send that version over and I’ll route it to legal today. I don’t expect much back, maybe just their standard notice address.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Sounds good. I’ll send the revised order form and the implementation outline in the next hour. If legal has redlines, just send them over and we’ll turn them quickly.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Thanks. Assuming no surprises, we should be able to sign by Friday.
